reference_sql:
WITH day_events AS (
  -- one row per session_start or purchase event from 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT event_date, event_name, traffic_source.medium AS medium, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('session_start', 'purchase')
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date, medium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'session_start' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase') AS purchases
FROM day_events
GROUP BY event_date, medium

WITH sessions AS (
  -- one row per day and medium: the sessions that started
  SELECT event_date, traffic_source.medium AS medium,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST([p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS VARCHAR)) AS sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
  GROUP BY event_date, traffic_source.medium
), purchases AS (
  -- one row per day and medium: the purchases
  SELECT event_date, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS purchases
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
  GROUP BY event_date, traffic_source.medium
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.event_date, b.event_date) AS event_date, COALESCE(s.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) AS sessions, COALESCE(b.purchases, 0) AS purchases
FROM sessions AS s
FULL JOIN purchases AS b ON b.event_date = s.event_date AND b.medium = s.medium

WITH day_rows AS (
  -- one row per session (user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id), then one row per purchase, from 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, traffic_source.medium AS medium,
    user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS VARCHAR) AS session_key, 0 AS purchase
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_date, traffic_source.medium, NULL, 1
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date, medium, COUNT(session_key) AS sessions, SUM(purchase) AS purchases
FROM day_rows
GROUP BY event_date, medium

solver.query:
WITH ss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS engaged, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_number')[1].value.int_value AS snum,
    traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
),
s AS (SELECT event_date, medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss GROUP BY 1, 2),
p AS (SELECT event_date, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS purchases FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207' GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT COALESCE(s.event_date, p.event_date) AS event_date, COALESCE(s.medium, p.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(s.sessions, 0) AS sessions, COALESCE(p.purchases, 0) AS purchases
FROM s FULL OUTER JOIN p ON s.event_date = p.event_date AND s.medium IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.medium
